interpretation.finding_1: the generic npu_fusion_attention rejects these shapes, so the model must be using the 910A-specific plugin (VLLM_OMNI_910A_FLASH_ATTN=1); comparing against the generic library is not the same measurement
interpretation.finding_2: sdpa materialises the N x N score matrix at 45.55 GiB, which confirms flash structure is mandatory on a 32 GiB card

verdict: the ceiling question is UNANSWERED; nothing here implies 69 TFLOPS/card is infeasible
next_round_plan: locate the Python entry point of the 910A FA plugin the model actually uses
call it directly on one card with the R159 plan parameters and compare the per-block time against 7.454/50 = 149 ms
sweep core_budget from 30 up to the full AIV count to test whether core occupancy is the bottleneck

key_decision_point: if the model's own FA op with all cores still only reaches about 41 TFLOPS/card, the limit is that implementation; if it is much higher, the 30-core budget is the bottleneck and a core-budget change may be far cheaper than a new kernel
